item.title: SO(3) Instantons
item.description: Recently I’ve been going through the Reading between the lines paper where they mention that \(\mathrm{SO}(3)\) instantons take values in the half integers (on oriented spin manifolds) instead of the integers like for \(\mathrm{SU}(2)\).
